search_text: published ZDI-26-172 ZDI-CAN-28912 Unraid Authentication Request Path Traversal Authentication Bypass Vulnerability 2026-03-09 CVE-2026-3839 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-3839 7.3 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L ['Unraid'] ['Unraid'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Unraid. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the auth-request.php file. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in authentications. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system. Fixed in version 7.2.4. title: Unraid Authentication Request Path Traversal Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Unraid. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the auth-request.php file. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in authentications. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system.
